amendment_reason: The v1 frame correctly abstained because development and confirmatory had zero test-only representative PR candidates. This amendment uses path-metadata availability only and does not use file content, Stage outcomes, Utility, benchmarks, or review labels.
purpose: Create a fresh temporal-code tranche whose sampling frame can test a code-curation claim without documentation-only or single-repository dominance.
utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
claim_boundary: Fresh path-stratified collection frame only; no Stage-B, Stage-C, Utility, or training-benefit claim.
